summary: The two halves of the comparison are each available but not joined: shell form for planktonic species (Zenodo 165514 with 2D/3D coordinates and morphometrics; Endless Forams training sets; CC BY 4.0) and sequences for the phylum (GenBank 315,003 nuccore records, 2,387 SSU; PR2 v5.1.1 release). A species-level key between the morphometric sets and sequence accessions was not found, Open Tree of Life matched taxon names but returned no foraminiferal source studies, and MorphoSource holds 75 foraminifera media.
next_step: Build a table of planktonic species present in both Zenodo 165514 and GenBank/PR2 with an independent tree (PR2 sequences), then pre-register the shape-versus-tree comparison for that restricted scope.
obstacles_confirmed: Shape-based names enter both the morphological distances and the labels on many sequences.
Taxonomic classification uses many characters, not form alone.
